name: 404 Settings
steps: Open Online Store > Themes > Customize, then select Theme Settings and 404 Settings.
Use a clear error message, a Home or collection destination, and a search form. Add optional imagery after the navigation is useful.
Preview a nonexistent storefront path. The page must remain helpful even if the optional image is absent.
Set shared defaults here. A section with its own override may retain that override; select the section to adjust it.
Preview a home, product, collection, and cart page before saving shared changes.

settings.label: Headline
settings.how: Enter the headline. Replace sample wording with your own content; leave optional fields empty when you do not need them.

settings.label: Message
settings.default: We couldn’t find what you were looking for.
settings.how: Write the message. Keep paragraphs short and preview long text on mobile.

settings.label: Primary button label
settings.how: Enter the primary button label. Replace sample wording with your own content; leave optional fields empty when you do not need them.

settings.label: Primary button link
settings.info: Store-relative or HTTP(S) URL. Invalid destinations fall back to the localized store route.
settings.how: Enter the primary button link. Replace sample wording with your own content; leave optional fields empty when you do not need them.

settings.label: Show continue shopping button
settings.how: Turn on “Show continue shopping button” to apply that behavior. Turn it off to remove that behavior. Other settings can affect whether the result is visible; check the section preview after changing it.

settings.label: Layout
settings.how: Choose one of the supported options below for layout. Only the selected option applies; other settings can further customize its appearance.

settings.label: Feature image
settings.how: Select or upload an image. Add descriptive alt text and set its focal point in Shopify Files. Check the crop on both desktop and mobile; the image does not change the original file.

settings.label: Top padding
settings.how: Drag the control to adjust top padding. Use only the range and increments shown below. Preview at mobile and desktop widths after changing spacing or dimensions.
